item.title: War and shortages push Gaza hospitals to breaking point
item.description: Gaza’s collapsing health system leaves dialysis patients, amputees and trauma survivors without vital care.

item.title: US launches ‘powerful’ strikes on Iran after Jordan attack
item.description: The US has bombed multiple cities across southern Iran in what Central Command described as a ‘heavy wave of strikes’.

item.title: Evo Morales defiant after new Bolivia arrest warrant
item.description: Bolivia's former president is being investigated 'for armed uprising' against the state, among other things.

item.title: Rescue operation in Argentina to free more than 100 snow-trapped tourists
item.description: Emergency services have rescued more than 100 tourists, trapped by a snowstorm in Argentina.

item.title: ‘Like volcanic ash falling’: Inside Aeon mall after Japan’s earthquake
item.description: Japanese PM Takaichi says 'race against time' to rescue those trapped in the mall and others affected by the quake.

item.title: US launches another round of attacks on Iran
item.description: Targets across southern Iran hit, including on strategic Qeshm Island.

item.title: Israeli strikes leave buildings burning in Gaza City
item.description: Israeli strikes have displaced dozens of families in Gaza City's Shati refugee camp.

item.title: Dramatic sea rescue as firefighters die on the Greek island of Crete
item.description: The Greek Coast Guard is rescuing people trapped by rapidly spreading wildfires on the island of Crete.

item.title: Why did Anthony Fauci invoke the Fifth Amendment? Senate hearing explained
item.description: The former top US health official invoked the amendment as Republicans questioned him over COVID-19.

item.title: Living with fear: Inside a southern Lebanon village divided by Israel
item.description: Southern Lebanon’s Mansouri village is divided by Israel's Yellow Line, a military boundary separating area it occupies.

item.title: After a deadly raid, a displaced Nigerian mother finds a lifeline in sewing
item.description: After losing her husband and two children, Safiya now fears losing the fragile future she rebuilt.

item.title: Japan turns to Canadian crude as Asia feels Hormuz supply pinch
item.description: Uncertainty over crude oil supplies via the Strait of Hormuz is pushing Asian states towards Canada's TMX crude oil.

item.title: Trump pushes fighter jet sale to Turkiye despite Israeli opposition
item.description: US President Donald Trump has again signalled support for selling F-35 fighter jets to Turkiye.

item.title: Trump cuts WHO off from Gavi vaccine alliance funding
item.description: Decision follows long-running feud between Trump and UN group.

item.title: Seven killed in Russian strikes on Kyiv, a day after Zelenskyy warning
item.description: Returning from the US, Zelenskyy says Ukraine's safety depends on allies’ willingness to provide anti-missile defences.

item.title: Iran war live: US attack kills Iranian couple, toddler on Qeshm Island
item.description: US strike hits residential building on Qeshm, killing an Iranian couple and their two year old child.

item.title: Saudi Arabia seeks international coalition against Houthis in Red Sea
item.description: Riyadh seeks partners to safeguard shipping in Red Sea as strikes on energy tankers expand, pushing oil prices higher.

item.title: Nicaragua’s Daniel Ortega aims to bar ‘traitors’ from future elections
item.description: Ortega has overseen a sweeping crackdown on civil society in Nicaragua and concentrated power in his own hands.

item.title: Israel slams Canada for statement opposing West Bank settlement expansion
item.description: Canada says that illegal settlements in occupied Palestinian territory undermine 'peace, security and stability'.

item.title: Trump appeals $83.3m E Jean Carroll civil verdict to US Supreme Court
item.description: The Department of Justice has issued separate filings in support of Trump's case to toss the defamation award.

item.title: Iraq calls Saudi-US attacks a ‘flagrant violation of sovereignty’
item.description: Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi cancels first official trip to Saudi Arabia in protest.

item.title: Sam Altman meets lawmakers on back of OpenAI agents hacking companies
item.description: US President Donald Trump says he is considering 'AI controls' following OpenAI's disclosure.

item.title: Is FIFA selling parts of the World Cup to private investors?
item.description: This week FIFA announced plans to form a new subsidiary company to run part of the World Cup and offer a 20% stake.

item.title: Myanmar court sentences activists to 37 years over election protest
item.description: Nine activists face prison terms of up to 37 years for protesting the military-backed December elections.

item.title: FIFA charges Argentina after World Cup final brawl with Spain
item.description: FIFA hits Argentina with World Cup charges for scuffle after final with Spain and 'Malvinas' banner after England game.
